name: Noda (Iwate, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Noda village emblem in blue: a four-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Noda, a village in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1961.

features.role: Noda village emblem — a four-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised swirl
